newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian blue chips down in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian blue chips down in sluggish trade.

text.p: Latvian stocks reamained close to this year's lows on Monday and most dealers were bearish in the short-term but were eyeing new listings in summer as a possible force to stimulate activity.
Total turnover fell to 51,000 lats on Monday from Friday's 107,000 lats and Saules Bank index Saule10 slipped 0.74 percent to 146.14.
The Rietumu Bank bourse index was 186.75 points.
Rietumu bank said that the index composition has changed with the addition of the Riga Shipyard, which makes it impossible to compare it to last session's index.
Most stocks lost ground and dealers saw no immediate factors that could serve as pointers to a change in the downward trend.
"It seems that people are still mostly out on the voucher market (ahead of big utility company privatisation later this year)," a dealer told Reuters.
"There are really no pointers in sight this week and the only remedy could be new listings, provided they show good results," she added.
Riga Transport Fleet registered the session's biggest volume in trade of 14,400 lats and it stayed put at 1.20 lats.
Most blue chips were lower to stable with only Valmiera Glassfibre and Staburadze confectionery gaining ground.
Staburadze added three santimes to 2.70 lats on volume of 5,500 lats and Valmiera rose to 1.44 lats from 1.40 lats.

It traded a small 700 lats worth of shares. "Valmiera's rise in small volume was a blip and won't have any impact on the downward trend ," Aldis Sipols, head of the Savings Bank (Krajbanka) securities department said.
On the official list Kaija cannery and Unibanka slipped while Riga Shipyard remained unchanged.
Kaija fell to 2.28 lats from 2.30 lats on volume of 9,600 lats and the usual market leader Unibanka registered a miniscule trade of 400 lats.
Unibanka slipped three santimes to 3.36 lats.
On the secondary list, the Daugavpils Chain maker traded 8,200 lats and lost five santimes to 2.40 lats and Rigas Raugs yeast factory slipped one santime to 3.70 lats.

Elsewhere on the secondary list stocks showed low activity and 15 out of 38 failed to be quoted on Monday. Mangali Shipyard was among the few coming above 1,000 lats level with 1,400 lats of shares traded.
It edged up a whisker adding one santime to 1.07 lats.
